newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Micro CEO gets 2.5 mln options - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Micro CEO gets 2.5 mln options - NYT.

text.p: Advanced Micro Devices chairman and chief executive W.J. Sanders 3d received a 2.2 percent increase in his base pay last year to $1 million annually, the New York Times said on Monday.
Sanders also received 2.5 million stock options to buy shares at $14.75, the paper said, citing the proxy statement.
Advanced Micro Devices' stock closed at 39 on Friday, off 1-1/8.
Sanders did not receive a bonus for 1996 but collected $2 million in bonus money carried forward from previous years, the paper said.
